kind: a loop that stops one early
find: [{ when: { linesLeft: { gt: 0 } }, then: 'next-line', label: 'Lines left to price' }],
replace: [{ when: { linesLeft: { gt: 1 } }, then: 'next-line', label: 'Lines left to price' }],
twinWhy: F's line loop goes on only while more than one line is left, so an order of two or more lines never prices (or checks the stock of) its last line; a one-line order is still priced, because that loop prices a line before it decides. The twin prices lines in the for loop of pricing.mjs · priceLines; its bound now stops one line early in the same way: n - 1 lines, and the one line of a one-line order.
